slides.title: UN: aid is reaching some areas, but looting continues
slides.body: What OCHA reports from the north

slides.title: Aid access improving, gradually
slides.body: OCHA says relief is reaching parts of North Wollo and Wag Hamra in Amhara, and some areas of Afar and Tigray.

slides.title: A hospital in Adwa was looted
slides.body: Humanitarian partners told OCHA the hospital was looted on Monday, Oct. 12. Other public buildings were also reported affected.

slides.title: Displacement continues
slides.body: Across northwestern Tigray, per humanitarian partners. OCHA says reliable, verified figures are not yet available.

slides.title: Returns paused in Amhara
slides.body: UN News reported a government-led effort to help displaced people return from Kobo was suspended after security worsened.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Allow safe, unhindered aid access.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
